frozen_universe.selection_rule: SUPERSEDED by addendum_A (concrete two-stage口径). Original intent: US common stocks, >=156wk OpenD history, rank by 60-day dollar volume, top 250, borrowable.

addendum_A_selection.reason: under OpenD <=300 historical-K quota, bars for the full multi-thousand candidate pool cannot be pulled to rank by dollar volume; a zero-quota pre-screen is forced, and its key is a survivorship/selection judgment (户部口径). US TURNOVER not a get_stock_filter field (都水 verified).
addendum_A_selection.stage0_zero_quota_prescreen: get_stock_filter US market: (1) security type = US-domiciled common stock (exclude ADR/foreign, ETF/ETN/CEF, preferred, warrant, unit, pre-merger SPAC; REITs kept); (2) market cap >= $10B (large-cap floor, operationalizes prereg 'large-cap'); (3) rank survivors by dollar-volume proxy, priority (i) snapshot dollar-volume = close x zero-quota filterable share-volume field if exposed, else (ii) MARKET_VAL fallback; take top 296.
addendum_A_selection.stage1_quota_fetch_and_rank: fetch top-296 + 4 factor ETFs (<=300, quote-only SIMULATE); rank the 296 by prereg-literal 60-trading-day mean(close*volume); apply dedup + borrow substitution; take top 250.
addendum_A_selection.dedup_and_borrow: per issuer keep only the single class with higher 60d dollar volume (tie<5% -> alphabetical first); walk-down borrow substitution (skip non-borrowable, take next-ranked, log each); if <250 clean survivors, universe is that smaller count labelled honestly, never padded.
addendum_A_selection.selection_effect_record: resolved commit MUST log: pre-screen key used, superset size 296, 296th-name cut value (both keys), and per-step exclusion counts. Names outside stage-0 top-296 that would enter the 60d top-250 are unobservable under quota — bounded, disclosed, cannot turn a fail into a pass.
addendum_A_selection.engineering_path: (b) deterministic code pre-screen: 营缮 encodes into resolve_universe; 都水 runs once on OpenD host; resolved list committed BEFORE results.

frozen_universe.survivorship_caveat: large-and-liquid-as-of-2026 over a 2006-> window is survivorship-biased; a weekly dollar-neutral long-short on residuals is far less sensitive than a long-only level bet, but the bias is disclosed and cannot turn a fail into a pass; a point-in-time universe (external, out of scope) would be needed for a clean verdict. The stage-0 zero-quota pre-screen (addendum_A) adds a bounded, disclosed selection effect on top.
